scheme_name: Revival and Rehabilitation Scheme for Defunct MSMEs and Cashew Processing Units
other_conditions: Applicant must be a defunct MSME in the manufacturing sector that has been non‑operational for at least 6 months (excluding units closed due to the plastic ban or diversification)
Only one application per unit is allowed
Bank sanction of a fresh working‑capital loan is mandatory to claim the working‑capital margin assistance
Applicant must execute a legal agreement on a stamp paper worth ₹200 and provide originals of any requested documents
benefits_summary: Provides capital assistance up to ₹15 Lakhs per unit (₹12 Lakhs for MSMEs and ₹15 Lakhs for cashew units) for building renovation, plant & machinery, electrification and working‑capital margin.
